parameters.title: File inputs: select paths and list directory files

parameters.text:
## Prepare and run

1. Choose **Demos → Add demo files to temporary user files**. This copies the bundled sample files into `/tmp/flowgraph-user-data` for this session. Use temporary files, not a mounted local directory, for this example.
2. Choose **View → Show All Node Details** to inspect the configured paths and filters.
3. Click **Run workflow** to display the results in the connected **Show Value** nodes.

These nodes select paths or list directory entries; they do not read the file contents. Connect a reader node to load the selected data.

**Select file** returns the configured path to `SpherePoints.csv`. **Select uploaded file** uses `ColorCardboard.jpg` from User Files. Both output a path as text; they do not read the file contents. Connect their output to a compatible reader when you want to load data. You can upload your own files through User Files and select their paths instead.

**Read Directory Files** lists immediate files in the temporary directory. The include expression `\.(csv|jpg)$` keeps CSV and JPEG files; the exclude expression `^Color` removes `ColorCardboard.jpg`. With only the bundled demo files present, both outputs contain just `SpherePoints.csv`: one as a filename, the other as a full path. Clear the exclude expression to include the image, or clear both expressions to list all files. These filters are regular expressions, not wildcard patterns.

**Download URL**, also in Inputs → Files, downloads an HTTP(S) resource and returns its temporary local path. It is not used here so this demo needs no network access. Temporary user files are session data; add them again in a new session.
